notes: Enhance: new setting 'Recommend upscaling to': 4K (new default), 1440p, or twice the size at most (what 0.42.0 did). A 720p or 1080p video's recommendation now goes to 4K; the AI is still blended with a plain upscale so it looks natural.
Enhance: the output sizes 720p / 1080p / 1440p / 4K now mean the short side, so a portrait phone video set to 4K becomes 2160x3840 (it used to become 1215x2160).

Enhance and Stabilizer: when the graphics card's video encoder fails (for example 'return code -22' while the card's memory is full), the video is made again with the processor's encoder instead of failing. The error message now shows FFmpeg's reason, not only its last line.
Clearer update message: 'Breezy Video will now close, update, and restart. Do not manually restart Breezy Video.'
